text: 你探索一处史前林间空地时，偶然发现一片植物，其物种正是密斯卡托尼克大学的古植物学家同事伊万·库尔托夫最近详细描述过的种类。人们原以为它们在更新世冰期前就已灭绝。可它们此刻就在这里，四处繁茂生长。你很容易采集到叶、根、插枝和种子；这些证据足以说服密斯卡托尼克大学地质学与生物学系资助一场大型探险。
有了这些证据，你们得以离开这片危险地带。你收好标本，带着三名同伴顺利返回北汉尼纳外谷。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 606
text: Exploring a prehistoric glade, you chance upon a stand of plants of the very species recently described in detail by your Miskatonic colleague, the paleobotanist Ivan Kurtov. The species was supposed extinct before the Pleistocene glaciation. Yet here it is, all around you, still flourishing. You can easily gather leaves, roots, cuttings, and seeds—everything you need to convince Miskatonic’s geology and biology departments to finance a major expedition.
With this evidence, you are able to leave this dangerous territory. You pack the specimens and lead your three companions without mishap back to the outer valley of the North Hanninah.
